note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the circumstance and the clauses are generic placeholders, never real contract text. The substituted datum is the supplied state of the circumstance — provided or undescribed, supplied states of equal weight (● and ◆ of the same area, colour and stroke); its only dependent geometry is the bracket, which marks the supplied section as supplied. No rule on conditions is stated: no condition precedent or subsequent, no fulfilment, no automatic effect, no clause that becomes due, binding or enforceable, and no jurisdiction. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): clauses (the circumstance card and the clause cards stand for the clauses), schedules, definitions and priorities (no priority or order between clauses is drawn). focusTarget has one value (the circumstance card's state row). No stress field is capped.
